review_notes: Reviewed all lines 1–134 and checked the basis construction and Module.Free.of_basis requirements. The basis construction supports a noncommutative semiring of coefficients, so the stronger assumption on A in instFree is avoidable. No other justified generalizations were identified.

findings.excerpt:
[CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] :
    Module.Free A (A ⊗[R] M) :=
findings.problem: The instance requires A to be commutative, although the basis used to prove freeness only requires A to be a semiring. This excludes base changes to noncommutative algebras despite the same proof applying.
findings.proposed_change: Replace `[CommSemiring A]` with `[Semiring A]` in the instance assumptions, retaining `[Algebra R A]`. The existing proof via `Module.Free.of_basis` applied to `Algebra.TensorProduct.basis A (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M)` works with those assumptions.
findings.benefit: Makes the freeness result available for base change to noncommutative semirings, without changing the result for commutative A. The empty-basis case is unchanged: the construction still supplies a basis when M is zero.
